text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nwoh, every single one of them... The 
pressure is intense! And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ura-ura-uraaah!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I know not where the blades will strike 
from...! Not a single one of them is a 
mere foot soldier!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "Target out of reach. I can't... lock on."

A chaotic, fiercely contested melee. In 
the end, neither No Reason nor Symboli 
Kris S were able to claim victory.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, that was quite a rough 
baptism. However, even amidst this chaotic 
melee—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lord Kris S, thy running was truly 
exceptional. Thou art indeed worthy of the 
Tenno Sho title.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That concludes this year's races, though 
knowing you, you are far from satisfied.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Next year, when you enter the Senior Year— 
you naturally intend to claim supremacy 
over the realm, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I... came to change the racing 
world of this country.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That is—my mission.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, change the racing world, you say? You 
truly are a dreadnought-class Black Ship.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That makes it all the more worth fighting. 
However, compared to that—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
How pathetic the Clan of Silence is. To 
think they've sent such a meager force to 
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Knocking those guys down a peg might be 
surprisingly easy after all! Nya-ha-ha!

No Reason burst out laughing heartily. 
However—
(Vroom!)

There was a lone shadow gazing intently at 
the sight.

An Umamusume of the Clan of Silence. 
Currently in her Junior year, she has 
already secured a victory and entered an 
Open-class race.
And furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That was an amazing race, Uni-san! This 
year was packed with legendary Umamusume, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If only I could run alongside 
someone so powerful. And then—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If only I could catch it, sink my teeth 
into it, and suck it dry to the very 
marrow...! Ahh...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: S-Still-san...???

"Zenno Rob Roy, the book-loving Umamusume. 
Still in Love, the Umamusume with two 
sides."

All of them belong to the same generation 
as Neo Universe and are Uma Musume with 
very promising futures. What's more, both 
of them...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The clan of silence, huh... I see. The 
next generation is rising up, one after 
another...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, we were short-handed today, 
but the tide of the era seems far from 
forgiving, hmm.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
From next year onward, I'll be completely 
surrounded by enemies... It looks like it 
will force me into quite a grueling 
struggle, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
No worries, I'll change even a fate like 
that!

And so, we held a strategy meeting for the 
coming year.
choice_data_list:
The older generation is strong, but... the 
younger one looks strong too...

The older generation is strong, but the 
younger one looks strong too, huh...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but fear not. Indeed, the quiet stars 
of ill omen are ascending to the heavens 
one after another, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There is still time before they grow into 
their own. Besides, who could possibly 
know the fate that awaits beyond that?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In fact, you and I overcame countless 
hardships to stand right here, did we not?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then! Next year will finally be the 
Senior Class. To truly conquer the realm—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Which race are we heading to next, 
Trainer?

"To make an even bigger name for 
ourselves, we should run the Spring Grand 
Prix following the winter one. In that 
case—"
choice_data_list: Let's head to the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, 2200m in late spring, is it? The 
level of attention will be unrivaled! 
Splendid, truly splendid!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Or before that, it might be wise to enter 
the 3,200m Tenno Sho (Spring) to prove 
that she can handle long distances as 
well.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Running the Kikuka Sho without merely 
chasing Lord Kris S's tail... Methinks 
that experience shall serve me well!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Being able to take a detour is 
truly the height of luxury!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now, raise your head, Trainer. Above us is 
a sky full of stars!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Unification of the realm next year! The 
one who rules the Twinkle Series for 
generations to come is none other than I!
